det:drp:fakecam.note: daq_sim cycle: drp -D fakecam -d sim:// configures through xpmdet_config.py against an emulated TDet receiver (rogue_dev) and records a run that psana2 reads back

det:drp:epix100.note: daq_sim up --det epix100 + cycle: epix100_config.py against psdaq.sim.rogue_dev, every pixel checked by psana2

det:drp:wave8.note: daq_sim up --det wave8 + cycle: wave8_config.py against rogue_dev (KCU and the IOC PVs in process), every sample and fex value checked

det:drp:wave8he.note: daq_sim up --det wave8he + cycle: wave8he_config.py against rogue_dev, every sample and fex value checked

det:drp:hrencoder.note: daq_sim up --det hrencoder + cycle: hrencoder_config.py against rogue_dev (PgpMonitor KCU, the encoder board over SRPv3), every event's position and counts checked

det:drp:epixm320.note: daq_sim up --det epixm320 + cycle: epixm320_config.py against rogue_dev (PgpMonitor KCU, the camera over SRPv3, its fnInitAsicScript), every pixel of the 4 ASICs checked

det:drp:cspad.note: daq_sim up --det cspad + cycle: an AreaDetector through xpmdet_config.py against rogue_dev; cspad_raw_2_0_0 checks every word

det:drp:epixhremu.note: daq_sim up --det epixhremu + cycle: xpmdet_config.py against rogue_dev; the emulator replays the frame daq_sim writes from the seed, every pixel checked

det:drp:jungfrauemu.note: daq_sim up --det jungfrauemu + cycle: xpmdet_config.py against rogue_dev; one 512 x 1024 panel of TDet words per event, every word checked

det:drp:ts.note: daq_sim up --det ts + cycle: xpmdet_config.py against rogue_dev and ts_config.py/ts_connect.py against simxpm's PVs; every TimingData field checked through ts_raw_2_1_0

prog:control.note: daq_sim cycle: control.py in normal mode, started by procmgr

prog:pyxpm.interface: pyxpm's XPM PVs over PVA (pvctrls.py/pvstats.py names) and its control -X ZMQ PULL port
prog:pyxpm.note: daq_sim cycle; simxpm also sends the timing frames to sim:// DRPs

prog:cLoopTest.reason: pgpGen4Daq card diagnostic (lab3-cam.cnf): makes the card firmware send test frames on /dev/pgpcam*; no role in a DAQ run

prog:qLoopTest.reason: pgpGen4Daq card diagnostic (lab3-cam.cnf): makes the card firmware send test frames on /dev/pgpdaq*; no role in a DAQ run

prog:qRead.reason: pgpGen4Daq card diagnostic (lab3-cam.cnf): reads and prints raw DMA buffers from /dev/pgpdaq*; no role in a DAQ run

prog:monReqServer.note: daq_sim up --meb + cycle: monReqServer meb0 serves the TEB's events in shared memory to shmemClient and AMI; its log names each transition it built, the BeginRun's time included

prog:shmemClient.note: daq_sim up --meb + cycle: shmemClient -v reads the MEB's second queue and prints every datagram's time, the BeginRun's included

prog:drp_pva.note: daq_sim up --pva + cycle: drp_pva -d sim:// records simxpm's camera PV (an NTNDArray stamped with each L1Accept's time); sysdrp_check reads every image back with psana2 against fakecam's seq of the same L1Accept, and drp_pva's drp_match_count equals psana2's count

prog:epicsArch.note: daq_sim up --epics + cycle: epicsArch -d sim:// archives two CA PVs of a stand-in IOC (softIoc on loopback) and a PVA PV of simxpm; sysdrp_check reads all three back with psana2

prog:drp_udpencoder.note: daq_sim up --udp + cycle: drp_udpencoder -d sim:// records the frames sim_udpencoder sends on loopback UDP; sysdrp_check reads every frame back in step with fakecam's seq, and drp_match_count equals psana2's count

prog:sim_udpencoder.note: daq_sim up --udp + cycle: sim_udpencoder -T sim:// sends one encoder frame per L1Accept of its readout group, paced by simxpm's frames instead of /dev/tpra, and prints each transition's time

prog:pykcuxpm.interface: the XPM PVs of pvctrls.py and pvstats.py and the control -X ZMQ PULL port, which pykcuxpm serves from a KCU card with the same PVCtrls/PVStats classes as pyxpm (pykcuxpm.py:18-19,111-114); not pvxtpg.py's XTPG PVs
prog:pykcuxpm.note: daq_sim cycle, as for pyxpm; simxpm also sends the timing frames
